title: cordula hirsutissima
intro: Cordula hirsutissima, commonly known as Hairy Cordia, is a plant species in the borage family that is native to tropical regions. It has been used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its potential to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cordula hirsutissima include its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing and protecting mucous membranes, and as an anti-histamine, reducing allergic reactions. The bioactive constituents of Cordula hirsutissima include flavonoids, saponins, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
